_comment: Ideal Customer Profile template. Copy this folder to businesses/<slug>/ or run /onboard-business. scripts/leads.py reads this file.
slug: NEED: lowercase-slug (must match the folder name)
target_customer: NEED: who buys from this business, in one sentence

hashtags: NEED: 6-10 hashtags your customers use, without #
keyword_searches: NEED: 2-4 phrases your customers would put in a caption

buying_signals: NEED: phrases in a bio or caption that show they need you now

usernames: NEED: competitors and big brands to skip

do_not_contact._comment: Leads matching these are set to do_not_contact by leads.py merge/rescore (permanent). Matched against name, bio, category and username.
terms: NEED: account types this business must never contact, e.g. competitors' resellers or agencies

challenge_library.name: NEED: an operational problem your customers have that you solve
signals: phrases in bios or captions that suggest it
challenge_library.evidence_hint: what a post showing this problem looks like
challenge_library.value_prop_hint: which brand.json value prop solves it
